messages:
ana: Quick heads-up — proposing a staggered unpin of runtime v3.1 in US/CA -> EU -> APAC canary windows tomorrow. Aim: reduce risk from the new KV cache behavior.

mike: timeline?

ana: US canary 09:00 UTC, EU 11:30 UTC, APAC 19:00 UTC. Deploybot window opens +5m each region.

sasha: FYI SDK team flagged a minor compatibility warning with sdk-js 2.7.1 + runtime v3.1 when longseq is enabled. Not blocking but worth noting.

kevin: Can we pin SDK to 2.7.0 for EU until we confirm? That would avoid mix of client -> runtime mismatches.

ana: That's the plan for EU canary only — soft pin via deploybot config. Will add exception for dedicated customers.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: unpin runtime v2.14 -> enable v3.1 canary in eng-us (1793459800), eng-eu (1793469000), eng-apac (1793490000). Rollout policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% on green.

mike: What's the rollback trigger? latency >2x baseline OR 5% runtime errors over 15m?

ana: Rollback triggers: 
- p50 latency regress >30% vs baseline for 10m
- token error rate >=3% sustained 10m
- kv cache miss spike >150%
If any hit, deploybot auto-rolls back and notifies #eng-oncall.

kevin: Add an SDK mismatch detector: if client sdk reports runtime-compat-warning in >1% of requests, pause rollout.

deploy-bot: Note: soft-pin target created for eng-eu: sdk-js@2.7.0. Exception list: partner-reserved, dedicated-tenants.

tara: I'm updating the runbook with the exact playbook steps and the rollback command. Link: https://go/runbooks/runtime-unpin-2026 (draft).

irene: Heads-up to support — leave a canned message for customers hitting regressions. I'll draft it after the runbook is final.

mike: One more ask — canary telemetry: capture sample traces with kvcache and with longseq enabled to compare. Sasha, can you add those evals?

sasha: On it. I'll push a short eval set and drop results in the thread by 07:30 UTC tomorrow.

ana: Great. Final checklist before unpin: runbook uploaded, sdk soft-pin set for EU, deploybot windows scheduled, oncall alerted, evals queued. If no objections by EOD, we proceed. :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup: from SDK.

mike: :eyes: watching the telemetry.

deploy-bot: Reminder: to abort window use `deploy-bot abort 1793456789` within scheduled window.
